recommendation: Keep this source fix. Remaining fulfillmentTime strings are legacy QUICK/CQL names or cross-version mapping metadata and should only be changed in a separate clinical reasoning/model-definition review.
issue_request: FHIR-7941 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 ReferralRequest.fulfillmentTime. It asked to clarify that a not-before date belongs in Period.start, a must-before date belongs in Period.end, and a bounded interval uses start and end.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit a7344a39aa35eeb8f52cb6d13a8e63eabd6105b2, which changed ReferralRequest.fulfillmentTime requirements to reference Period.start and Period.end.
additional_context: Later workflow and merge decisions changed the current surface: FHIR-10293 aligned ReferralRequest with the request workflow and FHIR-13196 merged ReferralRequest into the ProcedureRequest/ServiceRequest lineage. Current fhir.ini activates ServiceRequest, records that ReferralRequest became ServiceRequest, and maps ReferralRequest.fulfillmentTime to occurrence. ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition are active current resources, and their example lists include the edited examples.
reconciliation: Changed stale built-example references from ReferralRequest/ServiceRequest.fulfillmentTime.start to ServiceRequest.occurrenceTiming.event, changed interval-valued dynamic values from occurrenceDateTime to occurrencePeriod, updated the clinical reasoning snippet, and updated the $apply response example to serialize an occurrencePeriod.start.
source_changes: Updated source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-example.xml, source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-predecessor-example.xml, and matching ActivityDefinition invariant-test copies to reference ServiceRequest.occurrenceTiming.event instead of ServiceRequest.fulfillmentTime.start.

Updated source/plandefinition/plandefinition-example.xml and source/plandefinition/plandefinition-example-cardiology-os.xml comments and dynamicValue paths to use occurrencePeriod for interval-valued ServiceRequest timing.
Updated source/clinicalreasoning-knowledge-artifact-representation.html to show occurrencePeriod in the corresponding narrative snippet.
Updated source/plandefinition/apply-operation-response-example.xml to serialize occurrencePeriod.start instead of occurrenceDateTime.
